subject: Multitrait, multisite and random regression models

messages.subject: Multitrait, multisite and random regression models
parts:
Dear breedRs,

I have been working on the design of the User Interface (UI) for these
kind of models over the last few weeks.
Yesterday, we have had a fruitful meeting here at INRA and discussed
many aspects of the UI that I was not sure about. As a result I came up
with a document of UI *specifications* [1] that will serve as a guide
for the development process.

It is an open document, and I'd love to hear your opinions about it.
Do you like it? does it feel natural? intuitive?

If you have alternative ideas, or are curious, check the slides that we
used yesterday for discussion [2].

Note that almost nothing is implemented yet. It is still a wishlist.
But having a clear statement of requirements is key for efficient
development.

It is a major bump on breedR's functionality, and it will require some
refactoring.
Thus, it will probably take a few months. Although preliminar features
will be progressively available.

Thanks for your support, opinions, and patience.
ƒacu.-

[1] https://github.com/famuvie/breedR/wiki/doc/UI_spec_multitrait.pdf

[2] https://github.com/famuvie/breedR/wiki/doc/Multitrait-interface.pdf
